conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I got a bill for ₹8,000 on my card, but I didn’t use it! What’s going on?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s concerning, sir. Can you share the last four digits of your card to investigate?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s nine zero one two. I’m worried someone’s using my card!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’ve placed a credit freeze on your card. The charge seems unauthorized. I’ll file a dispute.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Thanks, but how long till I get my money back?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: The dispute is filed, and you’ll see a refund in 5-7 days. I’ll keep you updated.
